items.title: This Popular Healthcare ETF Is Diluting Your Dividend Income

items.title: Novartis, Bristol Myers pause autoimmune CAR-T trials due to safety concerns
items.summary: The deaths of three study participants led Novartis to halt development of rap-cel in multiple indications, while “transient” side effects pushed Bristol Myers to voluntarily pause its zola-cel program.

items.title: 3 Reasons to Sell BMY and 1 Stock to Buy Instead

items.title: Jefferies starts biopharma firm Braveheart at Buy after IPO
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies initiated coverage of Braveheart Bio with a Buy rating and a $48 price target, implying roughly 75% upside from the stock’s prior closing price. The move comes after the company priced its initial public offering (IPO) at $18 per share earlier this month, raising $382.5 million in one of the largest biotech debuts of 2026.
